description: Standalone Figure 2 alternatives: one left stimulus followed by withdrawal across length, plus raw continuous polarity trajectories across length for panels B and D, including a five-level full-model beta sweep for B.

metadata.brief_conditioning_reversal_protocol: unstimulated 0-200 s; left outer-40% cue at 2*alpha0 for 40 s; cue-free interval of 40, 80, or 160 s; right outer-40% cue at 8*alpha0 for 40 s with a 20-s cosine taper; observe 6000 s after withdrawal
metadata.polarity_score: Relative half-mass position x50/L: the interpolated point along the cell at which 50% of the relevant field's content lies on either side
metadata.single_stimulus_protocol: unstimulated 0-200 s; left outer-20% cue at 2*alpha0 for 40, 80, or 160 s, full for the first half then cosine tapered for the second half; observe 6000 s after withdrawal
metadata.threshold_latencies: polarize at cue-aligned Rac score >=0.25 for 10 s; depolarize at absolute Rac score <0.25 for 50 s; 0.25 matches the strong-orientation gate in Figure 2
